verdict.rationale: GitHub Copilot Autofix directly targets this story: it auto-generates fixes for code-scanning-detected vulnerabilities ('Apply fixes in seconds... Copilot Autofix'), is used in 'security campaigns' to reduce vulnerabilities, and Dependabot updates vulnerable dependencies with supported fixes. Secret scanning/push protection covers detection and blocking of another vulnerability class. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of Autofix accuracy and no detail on how automatically fixes are applied without human review.
